arguments.text: 6000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Aim: even effort near sustainable pod power (about 170 W shaft, boat ~115 W) after the hard start, spend reserve evenly, sprint final ~400-500 m. Watch for incidents: weed (push_local drop + speed dip at same pod power), pod drift (pod power vs heart rate / boat power mismatch), wind or current changes, radio course changes. Verify critical power with heart-rate trend at steady effort before trusting reserve numbers.

arguments.text: 6000 m, 1250 m legs; out legs (north, odd legs) have ~0.12 m/s current against, back legs with. CP revised from HR experiment: pod ~173 W (168-178), boat ~118 W; hull share 0.68. Easing piece ends 868 s, then paddler rebuilds (own pace ~178 W is about right). Aim: pod ~178-182 W, a little harder on out legs, a little easier on back legs; final sprint from ~450 m to go spending what reserve is left. Watch: drag/weed (GPS minus still-water speed at share 0.68 dropping in both directions), pod drift, radio course changes.

793 s EXPERIMENT RESULT: HR +0.48 bpm/min at 179 W, -0.38 at 169 W -> CP pod ~173 W (168-178). Set beliefs CP pod 173, boat 118: computer reserves now pod 58 %, boat 73 %. No drag change: GPS minus still-water speed at share 0.68 = +0.10..0.13 on back leg (current). Paddler compliance: ignored plain ease, followed a piece.
